reference.source_note: Variant of case-390 created for the reference pairing: the library's reference image for case 390 depicts Istanbul/Turkey (visually verified 2026-11-01), while the primary frozen prompt resolved the template variable to Japan. This variant resolves the same template to Turkey so the eventual reference comparison is an exact-prompt pairing. The library's image is NOT reused in this project unless its rights record is APPROVED (gallery/reference/index.json).

derivation.description: Same upstream template as case-390 with the variable resolved to 'Turkey' exactly once. The country value is INFERRED from the reference image's content (Istanbul landmarks: Süleymaniye-style mosque, Galata Tower, 'TAKSİM' tram, Turkish flags) — it has NOT been confirmed by the original author. Prompt-match level vs the reference: exact template fill with an inferred parameter, not an author-confirmed input.

prompt.freeze_policy: prompt.txt is the canonical artifact (UTF-8, no trailing newline). After gallery publication the prompt text is immutable; corrections require a new case id.

qwen_plan.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX 24 GB (gfx1100, native Windows ROCm)

gpt_plan.size_note: Pixel- and aspect-matched to the Qwen canvas. Verified against the official gpt-image-2 size rules on 2026-11-01 (custom WIDTHxHEIGHT allowed: 16-px multiples, ratio <= 3:1, 655,360-8,294,400 px, max edge 3840) — every case canvas satisfies them. Contributors may override; overrides are recorded.

verification.rules: Model attribution is never inferred from visual similarity. COMMUNITY_SUBMITTED -> REVIEWED_COMPARISON only after maintainer review of run evidence per METHODOLOGY.md.

notes: Reference-pairing variant of case-390: the frozen Japan case and its run record are untouched.
Country parameter inferred from reference-image content (Istanbul landmarks), not author-confirmed — labeled THEME-CONSISTENT, INFERRED PARAMETER wherever the pairing is shown.
Not counted as a 13th challenge: display surfaces count 12 primary cases; this variant appears inside case-390's comparison context.
